read_scope: Read the main issuer and every non-test module it declares, recursively through issuer dependencies, writer rotation, Notes observation/revocation, and the Text human/recovery/retirement/unsigned modules.
Read the actual registered writer, original lease callback, original HostAuthorityClock and DeploymentFrontierStore paths. Git object, byte length and SHA256 were checked when retrieved.

The inventory counts ten existing IssuerState compare_and_set sites. Each runtime site is enclosed by the same DeploymentFinalUseIssuer instance request_lock, either locally or through the private retain helper's actual original caller.
create_inner/provision initializes new state before the issuer is published; it is not an unlocked replacement operation on an already serving instance.
ordering_findings: Original protected paths acquire their lease/issuer/writer dependency fence before the issuer request_lock. The new metadata reader must preserve the direction lease state read fence -> same issuer request_lock -> original clock/store.
Writer rotation explicitly enters the pinned original retired-predecessor boundary before taking request_lock. Its callback does not call back into that lease registry.

Calculator and Notes install/update paths perform owner lease operations before, or after releasing, the issuer lock; they do not hold request_lock while reentering that registry. Notes's two-owner revoke is sequential and keeps its explicit intermediate/failure semantics.

Signed-grant and human-replay observations release their request_lock scope before later caller work. The Text recovery path delegates to the same original locked operations; it does not introduce another state writer.

No request_lock-held call back into the lease registry was found in the inspected production subtree. This is a concrete fixed-source call-path review, not a proof over future callbacks or unrelated owner instances.

Original HostAuthorityClock now_unix_ms and refresh_projection hold only their own serial lock through exact store/OS-clock work. Neither invokes the issuer or lease registry. refresh_projection performs original durable CAS and post-I/O sample; its future ceiling is not now.

Existing issuer metadata getters can read separate records independently. A concurrently shared Root observation must hold the same actual request_lock and derive proof plus revocations from one loaded IssuerState through complete final validation/encoding; composing separate getter snapshots would not establish one cut.
scope_limit: request_lock is instance-local. DeploymentFrontierStore/HostAuthorityFrontierStore retains actual protected records and per-operation publication locks/CAS, but it does not provide a lifetime issuer-instance mutex. This review does not establish cross-process or two-independently-opened-issuer mutual exclusion.
The actual serving Root service must use its same original issuer Arc. No new authority, signing key, replacement issuer or observer-provided trust is licensed by this inventory.
Original lease and issuer writer mutations, failed durability fencing, proof rotation and original expiry checks must retain their old scope. Merely using RwLock does not prove these properties.

v8_evidence.interpretation: Original500ms freshness correctly refused. Timings locate substantial original-lease serialization but do not identify the cost of a particular inner Artifact read, cryptographic check, journal read or durable CAS.

equivalent_shortening_review.finding: No justified equivalent step was found to remove from the original enrollment callback or move outside its existing witness fence. The original actual Artifact/Selection cut, previous/target journals, consumer nonce/frontier, profile CAS and final source checks participate in custody/recovery semantics. The durable store initialization/load acknowledgement also revalidates original bytes and syncs unknown cached state before success.
equivalent_shortening_review.consequence: Do not shorten by stale-cache substitution, deferred persistence acknowledgement, a larger freshness window, fake time, unbounded retry or an extra artificial refresh. The new closed metadata concurrency approach requires separate source review.

design_correction.issue: That design's broad suggestion to recheck shared poison after an old effect callback would add a new Err after an irreversible action, discard the original T/witness and obscure whether entry occurred.
design_correction.required_resolution: Keep every old dispatch/pair/pinned callback result path unchanged. Observation panic may poison later admissions; it must not retroactively discard an already entered dispatch result. A new metadata-only finish check may refuse its own response because that branch has no effect.
design_correction.status: Author accepted the correction. This inventory report does not by itself approve the new implementation.
